newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bernstein sees tobacco deal soon.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bernstein sees tobacco deal soon.

text.p: Sanford Bernstein tobacco analyst Gary Black said Wednesday he expected a deal in tobacco industry litigation within three weeks.

-- "We believe a deal between the tobacco industry, plaintiffs' bar, attorneys general, and public health officials will be be announced within the next two to three weeks," Black said in a research note, adding he calculated a 65 percent chance of Congress enacting the deal as legislation by the end of this year.

-- Black cited several possible factors: settlement talks went past midnight on Tuesday; tight precautions to guard against leaks; and sources indicating that Philip Morris Cos Inc stopped buying back stock about a month ago. Philip Morris declined to comment.
-- sees industry liability "capped at $12 billion per year, with $10 billion in guaranteed payments over 30 years...(at a) total (of) $300 billion."
-- reiterated outperform ratings on Morris, RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp, and UST Inc.
-- Morris shares rose 1-1/2 to 44-1/8, RJR gained 5/8 to 31, and UST added 1/8 to 27-3/4.
-- A spokesman for the tobacco companies was not immediately available.
